issues_found.title: keynv init requires interactive terminal
issues_found.description: Cannot run 'keynv init' in CI/CD pipelines or automated scripts. Must manually create project and secrets via CLI commands. This is documented but limiting.
issues_found.workaround: Use direct CLI commands: keynv project create, keynv secret create
issues_found.impact: Cannot fully automate migration from .env to keynv

issues_found.title: Secret keys must be lowercase/kebab-case
issues_found.description: Alias format @project.env.key does not allow UPPERCASE or underscore in key names. DATABASE_URL fails but database-url works.
issues_found.example:
keynv secret create @project.dev.DATABASE_URL --value x → fails
keynv secret create @project.dev.database-url --value x → succeeds
issues_found.impact: Developers must rename their env vars to use keynv (e.g., OPENAI_API_KEY → openai-api-key)
issues_found.related_github_issue: #1 - Secret key validation rejects uppercase characters

issues_found.title: keynv exec requires command in PATH
issues_found.description: 'keynv exec -- next dev' fails because 'next' is not in PATH for the spawned subprocess. Works with 'npx next dev' or full paths.
issues_found.workaround: Use npx next dev or node_modules/.bin/next

issues_found.title: keynv exec with alias in argv gets redacted
issues_found.description: When running 'keynv exec -- printenv DATABASE_URL', the output shows <REDACTED:...> because the redactor scans stdout.
issues_found.impact: Can make debugging harder, but is correct security behavior
